title: The 111 Mods
description: This modpack includes 111 various mods. It Includes technical mods - like Create and Create's addons and great mod for adventures - Alex's caves. Also the modpack makes Minecraft more lively with mods Alex's mobs, Sound Physics Remastered and AmbientSounds
body:
# The 111 Mods

A carefully curated collection of exactly **111 mods**, built around Create, Create: Aeronautics, Alex's caves and Farmers delight, designed to transform your Minecraft experience. Dive into a world where engineering meets nature!

- **Create & Automate:** Build massive factories, custom cars, and majestic airships.

- **Explore the Unknown:** Discover the depths of **Alex's Caves** and encounter the diverse wildlife of **Alex's Mobs**.

- **Refined Balance:** Thanks to **CraftTweaker**, every item has its unique place. No more recipe conflicts—just smooth, immersive gameplay.

**Explore. Build. Automate. Repeat.**

_Small note: even with all the optimization, recommended RAM is 6 or 8 GB_
